who: AppSec engineers and small teams who receive free-text command-injection reports against web applications they own and need reproducible evidence before opening an engineering ticket.
agent_work: The agent reads the supplied fixture source, investigates a reported CWE-78 route inside a disposable Celesto guest, sends bounded local HTTP probes, adapts after failed evidence, and submits a supported verdict.
proof_output: A verified, not_reproduced, or inconclusive verdict with an independent marker recheck, source hash, exact request recipe, and complete attempt trace.
